ranked_facts.why: Bilateral lens dislocation is more characteristic of Marfanoid features, such as those seen in homocystinuria due to cystathionine beta-synthase deficiency, than of general connective tissue disorders.

Tall stature with arachnodactyly is a distinctive feature of Marfanoid syndromes, which aligns more closely with the characteristics of Genetic Disorder with Marfanoid Features than with Multisystem Developmental Disorder.
